Messages.Author: KoKo
Messages.Body:
Deck Name : THE PACK
Author :
Description : Just wanted to share my !Gangrel swarm deck. Clearly not the best clan out there but I think they can breed and fight pretty well since Leathery Hide/Target Vitals/Follow the Alpha don't require any disciplines. The basic idea is to flood your prey with minions and just go forward. Blood gain comes in the form of Life in the City which ideal in the early game while you're making babies. Hungry Coyote is great later in the game when you have enough minions to hunt with 1-3 while bleeding with the rest. Considering adding a copy of Narrow Minds and/or Uncoiling.

Thoughts are welcomed!

Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body:
Looks like a pretty legitimate deck.

Follow the Alpha doesn't seem that great next to Harass, Rumble and Games of Instinct. I would switch at least half of them with proper rushes.

Up to half of the Targets should be Sticks.

Messages.Author: Jussi
Messages.Body:
I like the deck idea.

Switch Leo to one Janey Pickman.

Bay and howl could speed up your swarm, but in the end tribute might help you stay in the game. Twisted forest for additional stealth, or couple of Frontal Assaults for big "swarm rushes". Follow the alphas could go.

Couple of zip-guns and weighted walking sticks to overcome permanent maneuvers or damage prevention.

Uncoiling is a must because of Dragonbound AND Scourge of the Enochians. Narrow minds would be useful as well. Ivory bow to contest.

I'd be tempted to add 3 or 4 Ashur Tablets.

Master section could be something like:
1x Giant's Blood
2x Hungry Coyote
5x Life in the City
2x Sunset Strip
4x Tribute
2x Frontal Assault

Messages.Author: KoKo

Aranthebes, I really don't want to add BUT this deck will die if prey plays it. I think I'm gonna try to fit a couple in.

I've thought of adding a Gehenna module but I'm not sure I want to go higher in the total cards in library and am unsure about what to remove for them.

Messages.Author: Leijur
Messages.Body:
Well since I told KoKo I'd take a look at this idea last night, here I am. Originally this deck concept seems a bit weak on the power scale of what I see on JOL day to day. But with some tweaks it's got game against most of the common anti-weenie strategies. When he first told me about the deck I knew I wanted to include The Uncoiling as I see scourge of the enochians about half the games I play on JOL as anti-weenie tech. So this deck just tries to include answers to the most common anti-weenie tech. The delaying tactics were already there and are necessary. I had the count up to three on my first iteration but ended up cutting it back to two trying to keep the deck a bit tighter. Arenthebes is in since it's game over if he hits the table for your prey and gives you ONE source of intercept in the deck which is always nice. Took some of the suggestions in the response string. Games of instinct works very well in a deck like this so I included it as directed rush. I tossed in a few computer hacking just to screw up math for people who think your always going to bleed for one. Reduced the number of follow the alphas since it won't always be useful if you've got your prey pinned down for example. The Giant's blood is included because it's just a better life in the city that denies it to others who play big caps. Added some WWS for staying power. This deck will probably just die to a sniper rifle without some REAL luck and follow the alpha. Anyways here is my version. Think I tweaked the crypt to make it efficient to my tastes. You really want to draw at least three unique vampires and have them all in play so limiting dupes is good.
